results.title: [In This Economy] Pax Silica: What’s the Philippines’ trump card?
results.content: US President Donald Trump’s visit to the Philippines this month gives President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. a good occasion to explain what we’re negotiating for on Pax Silica

results.title: Philippines tries to ease tensions with China as ASEAN Summit nears
results.content: Chinese Premier Li Qiang is expected to participate in the 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits. President Marcos had said he wants President Xi Jinping to visit the Philippines, if the South China Sea code of conduct talks concluded.
